edits.modify_from: First walk through the demonstration frames and list the highlighted target at every frame; every frame where the highlighted target differs from the previous frame's ends one leg and starts the next, so the number of letters is exactly the number of such changes.
edits.modify_to: First fix the target slots from the first demonstration frame (the highlighted target plus every listed target; slots are spaced roughly 30 px or more apart in x). Then walk through the demonstration frames and, at every frame, assign the highlighted target to the nearest slot; every frame where the highlighted target is assigned to a different slot than in the previous frame ends one leg and starts the next, so the number of letters is exactly the number of such slot changes. A slot change always shows as a jump of tens of pixels to where a previously non-highlighted target sat. If the highlighted position is within a few pixels (under about 10 px) of the previous frame's highlighted position, it is the same target with coordinate jitter and nothing has changed; do not count it.
